name: Yangyang: Xuanling

tierList.prydwen: T0 Tower of Adversity, T1 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Havoc Sword Main DPS (Yangyang's alternate awakened form), one of the strongest DPS in the game across all endgame modes. Applies and maintains Havoc Bane constantly, alternating Azure/Feather sword stances, self-buffing CRIT DMG heavily (500%+ achievable).

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance / Feather Sword Stance (4 hits each), Stage 4 applies Havoc Bane.
skills.resonanceSkill: Feather's Edge - switches stance; enhanced Sword Stance Flow (Azure/Feather) restores 100 Melody + 1 Azure Plume when Melody is depleted.
skills.forte: The Way of Ten Thousand Voices - governs Melody (max 100), Azure Plume (max 2) feeding Heavy Attack: Azure/Feather Sword Stance and Mid-air Attack: Feather Fall, plus Feathered Oath (Havoc Bane-triggered CRIT DMG stacking, up to 150%).
skills.liberation: Hush of a Thousand Voices - consumes all Melody, Heavy-Attack-type Havoc hit, summons Shadow of Xuanling on next Sword Stance Flow cast.
skills.intro: Skybound Feather - Havoc hit + Havoc Bane, restores Azure Plume.
skills.outro: As the Wind Wills - 300% ATK Havoc hit + grants other Havoc Bane appliers +20% Havoc DMG Amplification after their next Havoc Bane application.

bestWeapons: Frostburn / Emerald of Genesis (80.3%, best permanent)
echoSet: Song of Feathered Trace (100%, best - 20% CRIT Rate + 35% Heavy DMG Bonus for Havoc Bane appliers)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Chisa is her best 2nd-slot partner (Negative Status buffing + Havoc Bane application), Suisui is the strongest 3rd slot for Havoc Bane consumers.

teams.name: Alternative Premium Teams
teams.notes: Phrolova makes an excellent Whimpering Wastes Dual DPS pairing.

rotation: Intro -> Basic: Azure 1-4 -> Skill (switch to Feather) -> Heavy: Feather -> Mid-air: Feather Fall -> Basic: Havoc in Bloom 1,2,3 (cancel via Ultimate) -> Ultimate -> Skill (switch to Azure) -> Heavy: Azure -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: one of the best DPS characters ever released - excels in every endgame mode (single-target, AoE, single-wave, multi-wave), F2P-friendly via free Rebecca, short rotation for the damage dealt. Her extreme self CRIT buffing makes Shorekeeper's CRIT buffs redundant, narrowing her premium 3rd-slot options somewhat.
